title: Memorial Gift
content: A memorial gift, in memory of someone important to you, is a donation made after someone passes to memorialize their life. By giving a memorial gift in memory of a family member or friend, you not only affirm your values, but recognize that these values were shared by the individual being honored. A memorial gift to the American Diabetes Association® (ADA) is always meaningful and a special way to honor someone impacted by diabetes. Nearly one in two Americans has diabetes or prediabetes. It’s a disease that affects us all and it will take us all to stop it. Your donation will make a real difference in our efforts to end diabetes forever. You can donate to the ADA in a person’s name or ask others to make donations in their name. Have any questions? Information specialists at the Center for Information are your personal guides to information on diabetes, donation inquiries, and ADA programs and events. Call 1-800-DIABETES (342-2383) from Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:30 p.m. ET. With your support, the American Diabetes Association® can continue our lifesaving work to make breakthroughs in research and provide people with the resources they need to fight diabetes.
